IN THE  HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION 
CRIMINAL WRIT PETITION NO. 1411 OF 2025
Ammishi Saarthak Kothari & Anr. … Petitioners
V/s.
The State of Maharashtra & Anr. ...Respondents
______________________
Mr. Chaitanya Pendse a/w. Mr.Vijay B.Dhingreja, Ms.Siddhi Bhosale i/b. V J
Juris for Petitioners.
Mr. Ashish I. Satpute, A.P .P . for Respondent No.1.
Mr.Pravin V . Desai for Respondent No.2.
______________________
CORAM  : A. S. GADKARI AND
RAJESH S. PATIL, JJ.
           DATE      :    8th AUGUST, 2025
P.C.:-
1) After hearing Mr.Pendse, learned Advocate for the Petitioners at
length, when this Court was not inclined to grant any relief as prayed  for,
he on instructions, seeks leave to withdraw the present Petition wi th liberty
to file an Application for discharge before the trial Court.
1.1) Leave and liberty granted.
2) Disposed off as withdrawn.
3) It is needless to mention that our aforesaid observations and
the observations made in Para No.2 of the Order dated 25 th July 2025, are
prima facie in nature and the trial Court shall not get influenced by the said
observations  while  deciding  the  Application  for  discharge  or  w hile
conducting the trial of the Petitioners.
 
(RAJESH S. PATIL, J.)                        (A.S. GADKARI, J.)
